edges.reason: msg.sender is written into balances during the constructor mint.
msg.sender indexes the outer key of allowed when approve executes.
approve derives the allowance owner from msg.sender.
transfer debits and credits using msg.sender as the sender.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender], so msg.sender controls the spender slot.
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping mutated by the safeSub operation.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
tokenOwner parameter is used as the balance mapping key.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
tokenOwner parameter is the outer allowance mapping key.
spender parameter is the inner allowance mapping key.
spender parameter is the key written by approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
to parameter is the credited account in transfer.
tokens parameter is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
balances[msg.sender] is read as the minuend of the safeSub operation in transfer.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the safeSub operation in transfer.
Result of safeSub is written back to balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
balances[to] is read as an addend of the safeAdd operation in transfer.
tokens parameter is the other addend of the safeAdd operation in transfer.
Result of safeAdd is written back to balances[to] in transfer.
balances[from] is read as the minuend of the safeSub operation in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the safeSub operation in transferFrom.
Result of safeSub is written back to balances[from] in transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is read as the minuend of the safeSub operation in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend of the allowance safeSub operation.
Result of safeSub is written back to allowed[from][msg.sender].
balances[to] is read as an addend of the safeAdd operation in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the other addend of the safeAdd operation in transferFrom.
Result of safeAdd is written back to balances[to] in transferFrom.

transfer invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance mutation.

transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance mutation.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is a pure mapping key parameter; it carries no independent state and is absorbed by the balanceOf function that consumes it.
spender only selects the allowance slot written by approve, so it collapses into that function.
The recipient parameter 'to' only exists to index balances inside transfer and is merged into it.
The source parameter 'from' only exists to index balances/allowed inside transferFrom and is merged into it.
tokens is the amount operand threaded into transfer's atomic safeSub/safeAdd pair and is merged into that function.
Parameter a is the first operand of the SafeMath helper and is meaningless without the safeAdd function node.
Parameter b is the second operand of the SafeMath helper and is meaningless without the safeAdd function node.
balance is only the named return slot of balanceOf and is merged into that function.
remaining is only the named return slot of allowance and is merged into that function.
Local c is the scratch arithmetic result of the SafeMath helpers and is merged into the safeAdd function that defines it.
